about_the_game:
### Plot

  • The game takes place in a small town surrounded by a dense and mysterious forest. The main character is an experienced detective who is hired by the mayor of the city to investigate the disappearance of his daughter. The girl disappeared a few days ago. According to rumors, this house has long been considered cursed.

  • When the detective arrives at the scene, he will have to face not only clues and riddles, but also the dark forces lurking in the house. The past of this house is closely connected with terrible events that led to tragic consequences. Delving into the investigation,
